description: A crisp, full-length black-and-white snapshot showing three figures standing on the sandy shore against rugged, textured coastal rock formations. On the left and right stand two men in fedoras, collared shirts, neckties, knit sweaters, and trousers, while a woman in a dark coat and collared top stands nestled between them. Taken around July 20, 1940, at Fan Shell Beach near Cypress Point in Pebble Beach, California, the image captures a relaxed family moment just prior to the United States' entry into World War II.
